newsitem.title: USA: Northern says Minn. nuke output delayed.
newsitem.headline: Northern says Minn. nuke output delayed.

text.p: Northern States Power Co has delayed full power output from its 544 megawatt Monticello nuclear power plant until mid-morning Thursday, a company spokeswoman said.
"We should be back at 100 percent by mid-morning tomorrow," spokeswoman Mary Heimstead said Wednesday.
Northern States had originally said the plant was likely to return to full service by late Wednesday after tripping off line Tuesday.
The Monticello, Minn., unit tripped due to operator error.

Although power demand on Northern States was not particularily high, the company has been purchasing electricity on the open market to make up for the lost generation from Monticello, the spokeswoman said.
About 35 percent of the company's power production comes from the Monticello facility and two Prairie Island nuclear units in Red Wing, Minn.
